Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, July 18, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
1. ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on July 18, 2024, at 10:05 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian Zadorian, Aleksandryan, Chairperson Vidor
  •  Absent: Student Commissioner Pogosian
  The Agenda for the July 18, 2024, Regular Meeting was posted on July 15, 2024, on the Bulletin
  Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the June 20, 2024 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.
  Approved as Corrected
  • Commissioner Tufenkian had a clarification on Action Item 6b brought forth by Stephanie
  Sherwood and stated that the Commission does approve of the funding for proposal to support
  GUSD Spring 2025 exhibitions however, the funds should not be used for artists as a
  participation fee.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Pogosian
  Abstain:  Commissioner Aleksandryan

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
  • Ms. Loreto Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

4. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - None

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  Speaker: Stephen Meek, Glendale Community Services & Parks Commissioner gave his input on the
  following:
  • The design for the new park at Central Library needs a revision, he requested the Arts and Culture
  Commission place art on Glorietta Park, and suggested keeping Brand Library pristine and using
  the Brand Library as an Olympic venue for Glendale he also suggested having art installed in the

  1
   alleys of downtown Glendale. Mr. Meek asked that these items be placed on the agenda in a future
  meeting.

6. ACTION ITEMS
a. Fremont Park Columns Tile Artwork - Design Concept Proposals
  1. Motion recommending that the City Council authorize the City Manager, or a designee,
  to enter into an Agreement for Commission of Artwork with an artist/artist team to design
  a public art piece for the Fremont Park Column Tile Artwork in an amount not to exceed
  $30,000 dispersed from the Urban Art Program Fund.

  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones welcomed Beau Basse of LeBasse Projects to speak, he introduced Catherine
  Forsyth, Project Manager for Fremont Park and she gave a summary of the project and introduced
  the artists to speak about their proposals.
  •  The Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby recommends that the City Council authorize the City
  Manager, or a designee, to enter into an Agreement for Commission of Artwork with an artist/artist
  team to design, fabricate, and install a public art piece for the Fremont Park Columns Tile Artwork in
  an amount not to exceed $30,000 dispersed from the Urban Art Program Fund, as more fully
  outlined in the July 18, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator:

  First Recommendation:  Cara Lynch, for the artwork entitled, “Belonging.”

  Alternate Recommendation: J Muzacz, for the artwork entitled, “Culture of Glendale.”

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Pogosian
  Abstain:  Commissioner Aleksandryan

7. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. 2024 – 2025 Work Plan Progress

The following updates are on programs from the Work Plan that have had recent activity.

a. CITY WIDE ARTS
  i.  Mural Ordinance – No Update.
  ii.  San Fernando Road Beautification Project – Update
  • Armen Avazian, Principal Civil Engineer of Public Works shared an update for the
  decorative fencing along San Fernando Road as part of the San Fernando Road
  Beautification Project.
  • The Commission asked questions and gave their input.

b. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i.  Beyond the Box – Update:
  • Ms. Lopez updated the Commission and stated that the theme of this year’s Beyond the
  Box program is “Art & Science Collide” in celebration of Glendale Library, Arts & Culture’s
  participation in the Getty PST ART Initiative. On July 10, 2024, the Artist Review and

  2
   Selection Committee met to review proposals. Staff presented the recommended twelve
  proposals for consideration.
  •  The Commission asked questions and gave their input.

c. PERFORMING ARTS – No Update.
d. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No update.

e. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS – Update.
  i.  The ACE Agency – Public Relations Update
  • Hanya Bruner, Sr. PR & Marketing Specialist of The ACE Agency and one of the project
  leads for the Glendale Library Arts and Culture presented a quarterly update on their PR
  efforts to date in addition to marketing and public relations strategies for the Getty PST
  ART Exhibit at the Brand Library & Art Center from September 21, 2024 – January 4,
  2025. The Commission gave their input.

8. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • The Commission thanked Staff and are excited about initiatives moving forward. Chair
  Vidor also thanked The ACE Agency for the updates, Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones and Staff
  for all their hard work and Beau Basse for presenting at the meeting and stated that its
  so fun to see that Adams Square Mini Gas station art installation has had a lot of
  engagement with the site-specific installations.

9. ADJOURNMENT 12:03 pm

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian

  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday,
  September 19, 2024 at 10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway, 2 Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206.
